title: Emergency Preparedness Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radio:test
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most emergency preparedness events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `radio:test` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your emergency preparedness data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
